translations.web: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.
translations.bsb: Cursing and lying, murder and stealing, and adultery are rampant; one act of bloodshed follows another.
translations.kjv: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
translations.asv: There is nought but swearing and breaking faith, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery; they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
